hero.headline: From fragmented data
hero.subheadline: We design and implement data solutions for organizations in retail, finance, and international trade — transforming raw data into structured, decision-ready systems.

services.title: Data Engineering
services.description: Distributed pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake), incremental loads, and Medallion architecture for scalable, governed data systems.

services.title: Business Intelligence
services.description: Executive dashboards, KPI systems, and Power BI reporting infrastructure connected via On-premises Data Gateway.

services.title: Data Strategy
services.description: Modernization roadmaps that move analytics off spreadsheets and on-premise systems onto a governed lakehouse on Databricks — phased so value shows up early, not just at the end.

solutions.title: Real-Time Inventory Anomaly Detection
solutions.description: A statistical monitoring system that watches inventory across hundreds of stores and flags unusual stock adjustments automatically — turning a monthly manual review into a same-day alert, before small discrepancies become real losses.

solutions.title: Automated Invoice & Ledger Analytics
solutions.description: Reads PDF invoices from dozens of suppliers and extracts the data automatically — cutting per-invoice processing from over an hour to seconds, feeding a live dashboard instead of a spreadsheet nobody opens. The same approach turns large accounting ledgers (general ledger, purchase records) into metrics finance teams can act on immediately.

solutions.title: Custom Certification & Training Platform
solutions.description: Many companies need to train teams on a specific tool, internal process, or compliance topic — and generic courses don't cover that. This is a self-paced trainer with spaced-repetition scheduling, built to turn any body of knowledge into a certification-style question bank that actually sticks, instead of a slide deck nobody reopens. I originally built it to stay sharp on my own technical fundamentals — because in this field, you either keep training or you fall behind.

solutions.title: CriptoRadar: Tendencias de Mercado
solutions.description: Pipeline ETL que extrae datos históricos de BTC, ETH y LTC. Procesamiento de indicadores técnicos (RSI, Medias Móviles) para identificar tendencias de inversión.

about.name: Alexander Sandoval
about.role: Analytics Engineer · BI & Data Pipelines · 5+ Years
about.bio: Analytics engineer with 5+ years turning messy operational data into systems that make decisions faster — inventory monitoring that catches problems before they become losses, invoice processing that used to take hours and now takes seconds, and dashboards leadership actually checks. I work hands-on, end to end, and use AI tools daily to move from idea to working system faster. Recently expanded into large-scale distributed data processing and applied statistics for production-grade alerting.
highlights: Real-time inventory monitoring across hundreds of stores — flags unusual activity automatically instead of waiting for a monthly review
Invoice automation that cut per-document processing from over an hour to seconds, feeding live dashboards
Turned large-scale accounting ledgers into metrics leadership actually uses, not just more reports
Uses AI tools daily to build and ship faster
